results.headline: Bibemi Gold Project Metallurgical Testwork Update

As such, the provisional indication is that capital and operating costs will likely be comparable, with significant operational benefits.

results.headline: Update on 2026 AGM Voting
results.key_quote: WPP has engaged with those major shareholders who did not support the resolutions to understand the reasons behind their voting decisions.
results.summary: This is a corporate governance update regarding AGM voting results from May 2026, not an operational or financial results announcement. The announcement addresses shareholder concerns about compensation committee resolutions that received 75.84% and 74.92% support respectively, falling below the 80% UK Corporate Governance Code threshold. WPP provides explanations for board decisions on restricted share award design and incoming CEO compensation. No financial performance data, operational metrics, or guidance comparisons are provided, making this a governance matter rather than a results announcement.
